contract.canonical_type: logical C++ value or void result and async effect; private physical ABI returns objc3::task<R>
contract.entry: lazy frame, explicit executor root start; nested private child inherits parent executor
contract.await: queued suspension and continuation; no blocking or inline cross-executor resume
contract.cancellation: cooperative; leaving private-child await cancels unfinished child; shared task_handle dependency remains independent
contract.cleanup: native frame, aligned locals/results, deferred statements, Objective-C objects, Blocks and captured exceptions
contract.interfaces: PCH and canonical semantic imports preserve logical effect identity; immutable source-free provider consumption
contract.abi_cutover: all objects, PCH files, semantic interfaces and packages require rebuild
contract.sanitizer_limit: runtime services and clients instrumented; GNU libobjc loaded as shipped, not instrumented
reserved: direct Objective-C object and Block results
